title: Israel strikes central Beirut, as number of displaced goes over 700,000
summary: Central Beirut was targeted by fresh Israeli strikes in the early hours of March 11, for the second time since the star of the war. More than 560 people have been killed and over 700,000 displaced - about a tenth of the population - since Israeli started striking the country. FRANCE 24's Catherine Norris Trent has more from the ground.
